# Sources re-review

Inspected commit: bb56af2180a660124b7278bb9e947d11264a5adb; sources diff against 52d2aa1 adds dependency extraction, records and documentation.
`python3 -I benchmark/scripts/sources.py --check` exited 0: 2 repositories, 523 artifacts; no native or semantic verification.
Recommendation: revise at bb56af2180a660124b7278bb9e947d11264a5adb.

## Standards
No naming, duplication or abstraction defect identified within the three inspected sources files; unrelated changes were not reviewed.

## Spec
Finding: [sources.py:172](../benchmark/scripts/sources.py#L172) records the identity as `package conflict`, the actual package name inside `version_constraint`, and kind as `VIPB declaration`. The pinned actor-framework `Providers/Actor Framework Project Providers 2024 for 2020.vipb:20` declares `zyah_solutions_lib_interface_for_actor_ini >=1.0.1.2` as a conflict. Impact: structured identity lookup cannot find this package, and the relationship is not explicitly distinguished from a requirement. Correction: preserve the raw declaration and source, record the actual package identity, `>=1.0.1.2` constraint and explicit conflict relationship; regenerate and re-review.
Six sampled identities/declarations: `Add File to Zip.vi`, `Caraya.lvlib`, `Error Cluster From Error Code.vi`, `systemLogging.dll`, LabVIEW and the package conflict. The first four match pinned `Core/Actor Framework Core.lvproj:102,107,119,200`; URLs and unknown constraints are preserved. Cross-project provenance survives consolidation, including `Providers/AFPP 2024 for 2020.lvproj:50,87,230` and `Core/AF Debug PPL Build.lvproj:20,32`.
LabVIEW `20.0` matches all three VIPB declarations at line 11. Project root `LVVersion` (`Core/Actor Framework Core.lvproj:2`) and package `Library_Version` (`Providers/Actor Framework Project Providers 2024 for 2020.vipb:4`) are excluded from dependency constraints; reading-environment metadata remains separate.
`Dependencies` and `vi.lib` folder identities are absent from declared records, matching exclusion of the root/folder at `Core/Actor Framework Core.lvproj:48,49`. Unknown project constraints are explained in [sources.md](../benchmark/sources.md#dependency-evidence-and-limits); VIPC and repository-wide binary/native unknowns retain explicit reasons and source paths in the bounded manifest summary.
Provenance spot checks passed: both prepared HEADs match the documented pins; MIT and Unlicense text and license-file SHA256 match; original SHA256 matches for Actor Core.vi and pylavi `tests/empty_invalid.vi`. Public origins match the declared pins in [sources.md](../benchmark/sources.md#sources-and-originals); online origin validation was not performed.
Unchecked: exhaustive dependency completeness, installed modules, binary linkage, package-member resolution, native loading, runtime compatibility, diagram accessibility and independent save-version decoding. Other versions/families, isolated evaluation, oracle, baselines and challenges remain missing or unreviewed; tool quality is unmeasured and benchmark readiness is not established.

## What next
Policymaker should request the conflict-record correction and a focused independent re-review. Resume from this report and the six sampled pinned declarations; avoid rereading the large JSON directly or treating a successful structural check as semantic validation. Candidate files were not changed.

No changes to merge.
